sql_query.query: UPDATE _care_recipient SET firstName = COALESCE($1, firstName), lastName = COALESCE($2, lastName), dateOfBirth = COALESCE($3, dateOfBirth), age = COALESCE($4, age), gender = COALESCE($5, gender), relationship = COALESCE($6, relationship), conditions = COALESCE($7, conditions), allergies = COALESCE($8, allergies), currentMedications = COALESCE($9, currentMedications), notes = COALESCE($10, notes), status = COALESCE($11, status), updatedAt = $12 WHERE id = $13 AND primaryCaregiverId = $14
